duplex_on_single_family_lots (by_right/p: Before 2023: conditional in R, with CUP required only on arterial/collector streets; Bill 2023-2 changed R to by-right. R-1 prohibited.
triplex_fourplex (by_right/permit/no): No in R and R-1; multifamily (3+ units) is separately listed for MR-2/MR-3, outside the low-density single-family districts
first_allowed_date: Pre-2023 (conditional in R on arterial/collector streets; MR-1 was the Two-Family Residential district with two-family dwellings permitted)
by_right_since: By-right change adopted 2023-01-24; effective date unresolved (publication date not found)
districts: Pre-2023: R (then Single-Family Residential): two-family conditional use, restricted to arterial/collector frontage and requiring CUP; R-1 prohibited; MR-1 was a separate Two-Family Residential District and its two-family dwellings were permitted per official use table. Bill 2023-2 eliminated MR-1, mapped those properties to R, and made two-family dwellings by-right in R. Three-or-more-unit multifamily remains a distinct use.
notes: Primary-use duplex finding (distinct from ADUs): Bill 2023-2 §5 residential use table marks two-family dwellings permitted in R and prohibited in R-1; §6, 514.03 Subd. 2 lists single-family detached and two-family dwellings as permitted uses. The Council-approved summary expressly says the ordinance “allows two-family homes by-right in the R District” and says R-1 has no additional zoning changes. Bill §15 rezones former MR-1 properties into R. Three-or-more-unit multifamily is a distinct use and is prohibited in R/R-1; the use table treats it separately in MR-2/MR-3. Adoption/pass date 2023-01-24 confirmed by signed ordinance and minutes. Bill §16 says effective “in accordance with Section 3.09” of the Charter; ordinary ordinances take effect 30 days after publication unless a later date is fixed. Actual publication date and thus calendar effective date remain Unresolved. Sources include the signed ordinance, Jan. 24 council agenda/minutes, code, and Charter. Pre-2023 baseline confirmed from official Jan. 10, 2023 Council packet/staff report and draft use table: R duplexes were not new in 2023; they were conditionally allowed only on arterial/collector streets, with CUP. MR-1 was the separate Two-Family Residential District; official table indicates two-family dwellings permitted there. Under the project rule that the reform must be a new allowance on previously single-family lots, remove the 2023 Richfield row from the reform count; retain a note that 2023 changed R from conditional to by-right and consolidated MR-1.
